focused.preActivationDiscoveryHome: pass with executable live-stage and Watch-Party spectator-route regressions

static.assuranceContracts: 28 contracts, 22 features and 25 escaped defects pass

findings.detail: Physical Android proof found the shared Home/Live/Explore destination helper bypassing the existing server-authoritative spectator resolver and routing public-free discovery directly to a host-capable Live Stage room path. Live and Watch-Party discovery cards now route by discovery item identity through /spectate, while upload, Event and channel destinations remain exact.

The repair passes only the discovery item ID to the existing resolver, which re-reads authoritative lifecycle, visibility, target and access state before choosing a spectator destination. It grants no room identity, host role, speaker role or publish capability. Exact-range Codex Security review found no vulnerabilities.
This is OTA-compatible shared React Native routing code plus an executable source guard. It changes no native capability, provider catalog, database schema, Edge Function, runtime or channel.

Public and Circle reads remain server-authoritative and ended or unauthorized discovery items fail closed in the spectator resolver. The prior internal-v2 OTA is retained only as emergency rollback material because it contains the known misroute; using it would re-freeze release proof until a safe forward successor is published.
